description: This file defines the EmpDependentDecorator class which acts as a decorator for the EmpDependent entity, providing additional methods for formatting and retrieving related data, such as date of birth and relationship type, in the context of the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: EmpDependentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmpDependent entity, providing methods to access and format dependent information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpDependent entity instance.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of birth of the dependent, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this dependent based on the employee number.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship type of the dependent, formatted with the first letter capitalized.
